The Disappearing Art of Thatched Roofs | No Workers, No Tiles!
Matkotha: A Living Heritage We Must Save!
Repairing Thatched Roofs Now a Challenge – Skilled Workers Are Scarce, and Potters No Longer Make Traditional Tiles. Explore the beauty and brilliance of traditional 'Matkotha' houses — two-storey mud homes that keep cool in summer and warm in winter. As urbanization spreads, these architectural marvels are vanishing. It's time to recognize, respect, and revive our rural heritage before it's too late.
